structured_output.rationale: 835 carries CO-22 on all three lines ($122.51 total denied). 271 for DOS 2026-06-04 returns EB*R naming Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as primary with explicit MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER." Claim was filed SBR*P to Delaware Valley Mutual (CI) as primary — wrong order. MOA MA04 is a remark confirming primary adjudication data is absent from this submission, consistent with COB misordering. Bill Medicare first, then rebill Delaware Valley Mutual as secondary with Medicare's adjudication data.

root_cause.explanation: Claim filed to Delaware Valley Mutual as primary (SBR*P/CI). 271 for DOS 20260604 returns EB*R — Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS — with MSG 'PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER.' All three lines denied CO-22.

next_action.detail: Bill Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (payer ID 1846349352) as primary with a new original claim (CLM05-3=1). After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Delaware Valley Mutual as secondary carrying Medicare's payment/adjustment data in SBR/CAS/AMT loops.
